Name: Meshullam, Overseer
Summary: Meshullam, a Levite of the sons of the Kohathites, was an overseer of the workmen repairing the house of the LORD under Josiah.
KeyStory: The overseers included Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites.
LifeLesson: Repairing God's house needed overseers from every Levite clan.
